hypothesis: Directly test whether C0 and frozen N2 are specialized for W0/W2 or whether N2 dominates both, explaining why adaptive-mixture v7 preferred N2_ONLY.
input_dataset: Digital Twin v1 synthetic only; seeds 20260926 and 20260927, 500 standard 7-rider races per seed, W0 and W2. No real/historical input.
conclusion: Frozen N2 dominates C0 on both W0 and W2 across both disjoint seeds and across the observed PRE-signal strata. This explains the v7 N2_ONLY result: the current synthetic pair is not meaningfully specialized, so selector/adaptive weighting is unnecessary for W0/W2. The next falsification step is broad W0-W4 robustness of frozen N2 against legacy C0/C1/N1, not further selector tuning.
claim_boundary: Synthetic engineering/falsification only; no real predictive, economics, ROI, promotion, live or production claim.
follow_up: Preregister a broad synthetic W0-W4 robustness audit of frozen N2 versus C0/C1/N1 on new disjoint seeds. Keep all real/economics scopes closed.
